thread:
Ari (CS): Hey team  kicking off Mercury Kitchens onboarding. Quick thread to confirm owners, acceptance criteria, and a lean 30/60/90.
Marta (Mercury Kitchens): Hi all  Marta here. I'll own business sign-off and provide product taxonomy + sanitized samples.
Ari (CS): Proposed owners:
- Ari (CS): program lead, enablement + feedback capture
- Tom (Solutions): integration, smoke harness, infra runbook
- Rhea (PM): acceptance testing, metrics dashboard
- Marta: business owner, data + procurement liaison
Agree?
Tom (Solutions): Yep. I'll aim for a working smoke harness and ingest check in 6 business days.
Rhea (PM): Acceptance criteria suggestion:
1) Latency: p95 <= 650ms on Redwood Dedicated under pilot
2) Quality: top-1 product category accuracy >= 87% on sample eval
3) Reliability: no P1 incidents during a 3-week pilot
4) Enablement: 2 Mercury engineers run end-to-end demo by day 12
5) Cost: avg inference cost <= $0.0048 for pilot volume (procurement alert)
Tom (Solutions): Small ask: allow 10% headroom on latency for very long descriptions; we'll add prefix caching as mitigation.
Ari (CS): Noted  will add fallback policy: route large prompts to quantized variant and surface degraded fields in UI.
Marta (Mercury Kitchens): Procurement flagged renewal review at month 9; cost target is important. We'll provide sample data by Wed after legal scrub.
Rhea (PM): Proposed 30/60/90 milestones:
- 030: sample ingest, first smoke run, enablement workshop (week 2), baseline eval
- 3160: 3-store pilot, perf tuning, Console alerts live, cost report v1
- 6190: expand to 10 stores, stability window, renewal packet prep
Ari (CS): Risk log (quick): procurement cost threshold, legal/PII delay, latency on peak, need for fine-tune. React with :+1: to accept.
Marta (Mercury Kitchens): :+1: Legal will review samples within 48 hrs. We'll likely request 60-day retention for artifacts.
Tom (Solutions): I'll provide a short ingest snippet for their repo:
```
# Redwood onboarding ingest example
export REDWOOD_KEY=REDACTED
aws s3 cp mercury_samples.csv s3://mercury-onboard/ --region us-west-2
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/evals -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"model":"rwd-medium-v2","eval_set":"s3://mercury-onboard/mercury_samples.csv"}'
```
Ari (CS): Workshop plan: 60-min hands-on in week 2 (SDK quickstart, evals, Console dashboards, cost controls). Suggested Tue 10am PT. @Marta can you confirm engineers to attend?
invite-bot: Calendar invite created: "Mercury Kitchens  Redwood Onboarding Workshop" Tue 10:00 PT  attendees: Ari, Tom, Rhea, Marta
Marta (Mercury Kitchens): Tue works. I'll nominate two engineers by EOD. Also asking for short-term SLA for the pilot endpoints.
Rhea (PM): We'll document pilot SLOs in acceptance checklist and wire alerts in Redwood Console (severity >= S2 to on-call).
Ari (CS): Next steps:
1) Marta uploads sanitized samples (Wed)
2) Tom runs smoke harness + shares logs (6 bd)
3) Ari publishes acceptance checklist + wires retention request (today)
4) Rhea readies nightly eval job and dashboards (week 1)
Anything else?
Tom (Solutions): One more infra note: prefer pre-signed S3 URLs and short-lived creds for ingestion.
Marta (Mercury Kitchens): We'll provide presigned URLs. Thanks everyone  excited to get started.
Ari (CS): Thanks team :rocket: I'll post the onboarding checklist and link to the shared folder after this thread.
